CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.title: Spark download checksum did not match
CHECKSUM_MISMATCH.description: The downloaded artifact was not installed because its SHA-256 digest differed from the release manifest.
hints: Retry the installation from the official Spark GitHub Release.

COMMAND_REMOVED.title: This Spark command has been removed
hints: Run "spark --help" to see the supported commands.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.title: Managed installation confirmation is required
hints: Rerun with --yes to confirm the change.

DISPATCH_FAILED.title: Spark could not launch a companion command
hints: Run "spark doctor" to check the installed companion commands.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.title: The Spark command arguments are invalid
hints: Run "spark --help" to see the supported options.

LEGACY_MANAGED_INSTALL.title: This managed installation uses the legacy updater state
LEGACY_MANAGED_INSTALL.description: The native updater will not modify schema v1 deployment state in place.
hints: Run "spark install --managed" to create a backed-up native generation.

NATIVE_PACKAGE_MISSING.title: The native Spark CLI package is missing
NATIVE_PACKAGE_MISSING.description: The npm installation does not contain the optional package for this operating system and architecture.

UNKNOWN_COMMAND.title: Unknown Spark command
hints: Run "spark --help" to see the supported commands.

UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM.title: Spark does not publish a native CLI for this platform
hints: Use macOS or Linux on arm64 or x64.

UPDATE_FAILED.title: Spark update command failed
hints: Run "spark update status" to inspect the deployment state.
